title: ML Pipeline & Model Serving Platformu
brief:
Bu projede, veri toplama asamasindan model deployment'a kadar end-to-end bir ML pipeline platformu insa edeceksin. Gercek dunyada Amazon SageMaker, Google Vertex AI veya Databricks'in kucuk ama fonksiyonel bir versiyonunu dusun.

Platform su asamalari kapsar: veri ingestion, feature engineering, model training, experiment tracking (MLflow), model registry, A/B testing, real-time inference API, model monitoring ve drift detection. Her asama bagimsiz calisabilir ama birlikte orkestre edilebilir.

Bu proje MLOps'un temellerini ogretir — sadece model egitmek degil, modeli production'da guvenle calistirmak, monitor etmek ve gerektiginde otomatik olarak yeniden egitmek. Mulakatlarda 'ML modeli nasil production'a alirsiniz?' sorusuna pratik deneyimle cevap vereceksin.

architecture.overview: Platform, mikro-servis benzeri bir mimaride tasarlanmis. FastAPI ana API gateway, Celery ile asenkron pipeline orchestration, MLflow ile experiment tracking ve model registry, Redis ile job queue management, PostgreSQL ile metadata storage saglaniyor.

decisions.reasoning: MLflow acik kaynak, vendor-agnostic ve kapsamli: experiment tracking, model registry, model serving hep bir arada. Buyuk cloud vendor'lara bagimli kalmadan MLOps yapabilirsin.
decisions.alternatives: Weights & Biases, Neptune.ai, ClearML, kendi cozumun
decisions.when_to_choose_alternative: W&B gorsel dashboard'u cok iyi — takim collaboration onemli ise tercih et. Kendi cozumun sadece cok basit ihtiyaclar icin.

decisions.reasoning: Model training uzun sureli islem — API request icinde yapilamaz. Celery distributed task queue olarak training, evaluation ve feature engineering job'larini asenkron calistirir. Redis hem message broker hem result backend.
decisions.when_to_choose_alternative: Basit job queue icin RQ yeter. Karmasik DAG orchestration icin Airflow/Prefect daha uygun.

decisions.reasoning: Feature engineering'i model training'den ayirmak feature reuse saglar. Ayni feature'lari farkli modellerde kullanabilirsin. Online (real-time) ve offline (batch) feature serving farki onemli.
decisions.alternatives: Feature'lari model icinde hesaplamak, Feast, Tecton
decisions.when_to_choose_alternative: Az feature ve tek model varsa ayri store gereksiz. Buyuk olcekte Feast veya Tecton kullan.

technical: MLflow experiment tracking ve model registry
ai_specific: Data drift ve model drift detection

functional: Model training job'u baslatma ve takip etme
ai_requirements: En az 3 farkli model tipi desteklemeli

import os
import pandas as pd
from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from api.database import get_db
from api.models import Dataset
from api.services.data_profiler import profile_dataset

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/datasets", tags=["datasets"])

UPLOAD_DIR = "data/uploads"
os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)

@router.post("/upload")
async def upload_dataset(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    if not file.filename.endswith((".csv", ".json")):
        raise HTTPException(400, "Sadece CSV ve JSON dosyaları desteklenir")
    
    file_path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, file.filename)
    content = await file.read()
    with open(file_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(content)
    
    if file.filename.endswith(".csv"):
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    else:
        df = pd.read_json(file_path)
    
    profile = profile_dataset(df)
    
    dataset = Dataset(
        name=file.filename,
        file_path=file_path,
        file_size=len(content),
        row_count=profile["row_count"],
        column_count=profile["column_count"],
        columns_info={"columns": [c["name"] for c in profile["columns"]]},
        quality_score=profile["quality_score"],
        profile=profile
    )
    db.add(dataset)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(dataset)
    
    return {
        "id": dataset.id,
        "name": dataset.name,
        "profile": profile
    }

@router.get("/")
async def list_datasets(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    return db.query(Dataset).all()

substeps.code:
@router.post("/{dataset_id}/clean")
async def clean_dataset(
    dataset_id: int,
    strategy: str = "mean",
    outlier_method: str = "iqr",
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    dataset = db.query(Dataset).filter(Dataset.id == dataset_id).first()
    if not dataset:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Dataset bulunamadı")
    
    df = pd.read_csv(dataset.file_path)
    cleaner = DataCleaner(df)
    cleaned_df, report = (
        cleaner
        .handle_missing_values(strategy=strategy)
        .detect_outliers(method=outlier_method)
        .clean()
    )
    
    cleaned_path = dataset.file_path.replace(".csv", "_cleaned.csv")
    cleaned_df.to_csv(cleaned_path, index=False)
    
    return {"report": report, "cleaned_path": cleaned_path}
substeps.why: Temizleme endpoint'i dataset ID'si ile çağrılır ve stratejiye göre veriyi temizler. Temizlenmiş veri ayrı dosyaya kaydedilir — orijinal veri korunur.

from api.services.dataset_versioner import compare_datasets
from api.models import DatasetVersion

@router.post("/{dataset_id}/version")
async def create_version(
    dataset_id: int,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    original = db.query(Dataset).filter(Dataset.id == dataset_id).first()
    if not original:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Dataset bulunamadı")
    
    latest_version = db.query(DatasetVersion).filter(
        DatasetVersion.dataset_id == dataset_id
    ).order_by(DatasetVersion.version.desc()).first()
    
    new_version_num = (latest_version.version + 1) if latest_version else 2
    
    file_path = f"data/uploads/{original.name}_v{new_version_num}.csv"
    content = await file.read()
    with open(file_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(content)
    
    new_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    old_df = pd.read_csv(original.file_path)
    profile = profile_dataset(new_df)
    changes = compare_datasets(old_df, new_df)
    
    version = DatasetVersion(
        dataset_id=dataset_id,
        version=new_version_num,
        file_path=file_path,
        row_count=profile["row_count"],
        column_count=profile["column_count"],
        quality_score=profile["quality_score"],
        profile=profile,
        changes_summary=changes
    )
    db.add(version)
    db.commit()
    
    return {"version": new_version_num, "changes": changes}

@router.get("/{dataset_id}/versions")
async def list_versions(dataset_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional
from api.database import get_db
from features.feature_store import FeatureStore
import pandas as pd

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/features", tags=["features"])
store = FeatureStore()

class FeatureRegisterRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str
    source_column: str
    transform_type: str
    description: Optional[str] = ""

@router.post("/register")
async def register_feature(request: FeatureRegisterRequest):
    feature = store.register_feature(
        name=request.name,
        source_column=request.source_column,
        transform_type=request.transform_type,
        description=request.description
    )
    return feature

@router.post("/compute/{feature_name}")
async def compute_feature(feature_name: str, dataset_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    from api.models import Dataset

    df = pd.read_csv(dataset.file_path)
    result = store.compute_feature(feature_name, df)
    return {"feature": feature_name, "computed_rows": len(result), "sample": result.head().tolist()}

    return store.list_features()

import os
import mlflow
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_score, recall_score
import joblib
from workers.celery_app import celery_app
from features.transformers import FeaturePipelineBuilder

MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI = os.getenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", "http://localhost:5000")
mlflow.set_tracking_uri(MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI)

MODEL_MAP = {
    "random_forest": RandomForestClassifier,
    "gradient_boosting": GradientBoostingClassifier,
    "logistic_regression": LogisticRegression
}

@celery_app.task(bind=True, name="train_model")
def train_model(self, config: dict):
    try:
        self.update_state(state="LOADING_DATA", meta={"progress": 10})
        df = pd.read_csv(config["dataset_path"])
        target_col = config["target_column"]
        X = df.drop(columns=[target_col])
        y = df[target_col]
        
        self.update_state(state="FEATURE_ENGINEERING", meta={"progress": 25})
        builder = FeaturePipelineBuilder()
        builder.detect_column_types(X)
        preprocessor = builder.build()
        X_transformed = preprocessor.fit_transform(X)
        
        self.update_state(state="TRAINING", meta={"progress": 50})
        model_type = config.get("model_type", "random_forest")
        model_params = config.get("params", {})
        ModelClass = MODEL_MAP.get(model_type, RandomForestClassifier)
        model = ModelClass(**model_params)
        
        experiment_name = config.get("experiment_name", "default")
        mlflow.set_experiment(experiment_name)
        
        with mlflow.start_run(run_name=config.get("run_name", f"{model_type}_run")):
            mlflow.log_params(config.get("params", {}))
            mlflow.log_param("model_type", model_type)
            mlflow.log_param("dataset", config["dataset_path"])
            
            self.update_state(state="CROSS_VALIDATION", meta={"progress": 60})
            cv_scores = cross_val_score(model, X_transformed, y, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")
            
            model.fit(X_transformed, y)
            predictions = model.predict(X_transformed)
            
            metrics = {
                "accuracy": round(accuracy_score(y, predictions), 4),
                "f1_score": round(f1_score(y, predictions, average="weighted"), 4),
                "precision": round(precision_score(y, predictions, average="weighted"), 4),
                "recall": round(recall_score(y, predictions, average="weighted"), 4),
                "cv_mean": round(float(cv_scores.mean()), 4),
                "cv_std": round(float(cv_scores.std()), 4)
            }
            mlflow.log_metrics(metrics)
            
            self.update_state(state="SAVING_MODEL", meta={"progress": 85})
            mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, "model")
            
            pipeline_path = f"artifacts/pipeline_{model_type}.joblib"
            os.makedirs("artifacts", exist_ok=True)
            joblib.dump(preprocessor, pipeline_path)
            mlflow.log_artifact(pipeline_path)
            
            run_id = mlflow.active_run().info.run_id
        
        self.update_state(state="COMPLETED", meta={"progress": 100})
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "run_id": run_id,
            "metrics": metrics,
            "model_type": model_type
        }
    except Exception as e:
        self.update_state(state="FAILED", meta={"error": str(e)})
        raise
substeps.why: Training task'ı Celery worker'da asenkron çalışır. Her adımda progress günceller (LOADING_DATA → TRAINING → COMPLETED). MLflow ile tüm parametreler, metrikler ve model artifact'ı loglanır.
Training endpoint'i asenkron yapıda çalışır: start → status takibi → sonuç alma. cancel endpoint'i ile uzun süren eğitimleri iptal edebilirsin.

mlflow.set_tracking_uri(MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/experiments", tags=["experiments"])

@router.get("/")
async def list_experiments():
    experiments = mlflow.search_experiments()
    return [
        {
            "id": exp.experiment_id,
            "name": exp.name,
            "artifact_location": exp.artifact_location,
            "lifecycle_stage": exp.lifecycle_stage
        }
        for exp in experiments
    ]

@router.get("/{experiment_id}/runs")
async def list_runs(experiment_id: str, max_results: int = 50):
    runs = mlflow.search_runs(
        experiment_ids=[experiment_id],
        max_results=max_results,
        order_by=["metrics.accuracy DESC"]
    )
    if runs.empty:
        return []
    return runs.to_dict(orient="records")

@router.get("/runs/{run_id}")
async def get_run_details(run_id: str):
    run = mlflow.get_run(run_id)
    return {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "status": run.info.status,
        "params": run.data.params,
        "metrics": run.data.metrics,
        "tags": run.data.tags,
        "start_time": run.info.start_time,
        "end_time": run.info.end_time,
        "artifact_uri": run.info.artifact_uri
    }

@router.get("/compare")
async def compare_runs(run_ids: str):
    ids = run_ids.split(",")
    results = []
    for rid in ids:
        run = mlflow.get_run(rid.strip())
        results.append({
            "run_id": rid.strip(),
            "params": run.data.params,
            "metrics": run.data.metrics
        })
    return results

import itertools
import random
import mlflow
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional

class HyperparameterSearch:
    def __init__(self, model_class, param_space: Dict[str, List], experiment_name: str):
        self.model_class = model_class
        self.param_space = param_space
        self.experiment_name = experiment_name
        self.results: List[Dict] = []
    
    def grid_search(self, X, y, cv: int = 5) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        keys = self.param_space.keys()
        values = self.param_space.values()
        best_score = -1
        best_params = {}
        
        mlflow.set_experiment(self.experiment_name)
        
        for combo in itertools.product(*values):
            params = dict(zip(keys, combo))
            with mlflow.start_run(run_name=f"grid_{hash(str(params)) % 10000}"):
                mlflow.log_params(params)
                model = self.model_class(**params)
                scores = cross_val_score(model, X, y, cv=cv, scoring="accuracy")
                mean_score = float(scores.mean())
                mlflow.log_metric("cv_accuracy", mean_score)
                mlflow.log_metric("cv_std", float(scores.std()))
                
                self.results.append({"params": params, "score": mean_score})
                if mean_score > best_score:
                    best_score = mean_score
                    best_params = params
        
        return {"best_params": best_params, "best_score": round(best_score, 4), "total_trials": len(self.results)}
    
    def random_search(self, X, y, n_iter: int = 10, cv: int = 5) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        best_score = -1
        best_params = {}
        
        mlflow.set_experiment(self.experiment_name)
        
        for i in range(n_iter):
            params = {k: random.choice(v) for k, v in self.param_space.items()}
            with mlflow.start_run(run_name=f"random_{i}"):
                mlflow.log_params(params)
                model = self.model_class(**params)
                scores = cross_val_score(model, X, y, cv=cv, scoring="accuracy")
                mean_score = float(scores.mean())
                mlflow.log_metric("cv_accuracy", mean_score)
                mlflow.log_metric("cv_std", float(scores.std()))
                
                self.results.append({"params": params, "score": mean_score})
                if mean_score > best_score:
                    best_score = mean_score
                    best_params = params
        
        return {"best_params": best_params, "best_score": round(best_score, 4), "total_trials": n_iter}
substeps.why: Grid search tüm kombinasyonları dener (az parametre için), random search rastgele örnekler (çok parametre için). Her deneme MLflow'a loglanır — sonra karşılaştırabilirsin.

@celery_app.task(bind=True, name="hyperparameter_search")
def hyperparameter_search(self, config: dict):
    from ml.hyperparameter_search import HyperparameterSearch
    
    self.update_state(state="LOADING", meta={"progress": 10})
    df = pd.read_csv(config["dataset_path"])
    target_col = config["target_column"]
    X = df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    y = df[target_col]
    
    builder = FeaturePipelineBuilder()
    builder.detect_column_types(X)
    preprocessor = builder.build()
    X_transformed = preprocessor.fit_transform(X)
    
    ModelClass = MODEL_MAP.get(config["model_type"], RandomForestClassifier)
    search = HyperparameterSearch(
        model_class=ModelClass,
        param_space=config["param_space"],
        experiment_name=config.get("experiment_name", "hp_search")
    )
    
    self.update_state(state="SEARCHING", meta={"progress": 30})
    method = config.get("search_method", "random")
    if method == "grid":
        result = search.grid_search(X_transformed, y)
    else:
        result = search.random_search(X_transformed, y, n_iter=config.get("n_iter", 10))
    
    self.update_state(state="COMPLETED", meta={"progress": 100})
    return result

import os
import mlflow
import joblib
import numpy as np
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI = os.getenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", "http://localhost:5000")
mlflow.set_tracking_uri(MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI)

class ModelServer:
    def __init__(self):
        self._model = None
        self._pipeline = None
        self._model_version = None
        self._model_name = None
    
    def load_production_model(self, model_name: str) -> bool:
        try:
            model_uri = f"models:/{model_name}/Production"
            self._model = mlflow.sklearn.load_model(model_uri)
            
            client = mlflow.tracking.MlflowClient()
            versions = client.get_latest_versions(model_name, stages=["Production"])
            if versions:
                self._model_version = versions[0].version
                run = mlflow.get_run(versions[0].run_id)
                artifact_uri = run.info.artifact_uri
            
            self._model_name = model_name
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Model yukleme hatasi: {e}")
            return False
    
    def predict(self, features: np.ndarray) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if self._model is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Model yuklenmemis")
        
        prediction = self._model.predict(features)
        result = {"prediction": prediction.tolist(), "model_version": self._model_version}
        
        if hasattr(self._model, 'predict_proba'):
            probabilities = self._model.predict_proba(features)
            result["confidence"] = float(np.max(probabilities, axis=1)[0])
            result["probabilities"] = probabilities.tolist()
        
        return result
    
    @property
    def is_loaded(self) -> bool:
        return self._model is not None

model_server = ModelServer()

import time
import numpy as np
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from ml.model_server import model_server
from features.transformers import FeaturePipelineBuilder

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/predict", tags=["inference"])

class PredictionRequest(BaseModel):
    model_name: str = "churn_predictor"
    features: Dict[str, Any]

class PredictionResponse(BaseModel):
    prediction: Any
    confidence: float = 0.0
    model_version: str = ""
    latency_ms: float = 0.0

@router.post("/", response_model=PredictionResponse)
async def predict(request: PredictionRequest):
    start = time.time()
    
    if not model_server.is_loaded:
        loaded = model_server.load_production_model(request.model_name)
        if not loaded:
            raise HTTPException(503, "Model yuklenemedi. Production modeli kontrol edin.")
    
    try:
        import pandas as pd
        input_df = pd.DataFrame([request.features])
        builder = FeaturePipelineBuilder()
        builder.detect_column_types(input_df)
        preprocessor = builder.build()
        transformed = preprocessor.fit_transform(input_df)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(400, f"Feature transform hatasi: {str(e)}")
    
    result = model_server.predict(transformed)
    latency = (time.time() - start) * 1000
    
    return PredictionResponse(
        prediction=result["prediction"][0] if isinstance(result["prediction"], list) else result["prediction"],
        confidence=result.get("confidence", 0.0),
        model_version=str(result.get("model_version", "")),
        latency_ms=round(latency, 2)
    )

@router.post("/load/{model_name}")
async def load_model(model_name: str):
    loaded = model_server.load_production_model(model_name)
    if not loaded:
        raise HTTPException(503, f"Model '{model_name}' yuklenemedi")
    return {"status": "loaded", "model_name": model_name}

@celery_app.task(bind=True, name="batch_predict")
def batch_predict(self, config: dict):
    import time
    self.update_state(state="LOADING", meta={"progress": 10})
    
    df = pd.read_csv(config["input_path"])
    total_rows = len(df)
    
    model_name = config["model_name"]
    model_uri = f"models:/{model_name}/Production"
    model = mlflow.sklearn.load_model(model_uri)
    
    self.update_state(state="PREDICTING", meta={"progress": 30})
    
    target_col = config.get("target_column")
    if target_col and target_col in df.columns:
        X = df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    else:
        X = df
    
    builder = FeaturePipelineBuilder()
    builder.detect_column_types(X)
    preprocessor = builder.build()
    X_transformed = preprocessor.fit_transform(X)
    
    predictions = model.predict(X_transformed)
    df["prediction"] = predictions
    
    if hasattr(model, 'predict_proba'):
        probabilities = model.predict_proba(X_transformed)
        df["confidence"] = np.max(probabilities, axis=1)
    
    output_path = config["input_path"].replace(".csv", "_predictions.csv")
    df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
    self.update_state(state="COMPLETED", meta={"progress": 100})
    return {
        "status": "completed",
        "total_rows": total_rows,
        "output_path": output_path
    }

steps.title: Model Performance Degradation
steps.why: Model accuracy zamanla duser (concept drift). Ground truth geldikce performansi karsilastir.
steps.instructions:
Model drift:
1. Ground truth (gercek sonuclar) toplama mekanizmasi
2. Periyodik accuracy hesaplama
3. Baseline accuracy ile karsilastir
4. Performance drop alert
5. Trend grafigi
steps.checkpoint: Accuracy dustugunde alert tetikleniyor mu?

substeps.code:
import numpy as np
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import deque
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score

class PerformanceMonitor:
    def __init__(self, baseline_accuracy: float = 0.0, alert_threshold: float = 0.05):
        self.baseline_accuracy = baseline_accuracy
        self.alert_threshold = alert_threshold
        self.ground_truth_log: deque = deque(maxlen=10000)
        self.alerts: List[Dict] = []
    
    def set_baseline(self, accuracy: float):
        self.baseline_accuracy = accuracy
    
    def log_ground_truth(self, prediction: Any, actual: Any, model_version: str):
        self.ground_truth_log.append({
            "prediction": prediction,
            "actual": actual,
            "model_version": model_version,
            "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        })
    
    def calculate_performance(self, window_hours: int = 24) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(hours=window_hours)
        recent = [
            l for l in self.ground_truth_log
            if datetime.fromisoformat(l["timestamp"]) > cutoff
        ]
        
        if len(recent) < 10:
            return {"status": "insufficient_data", "count": len(recent)}
        
        predictions = [l["prediction"] for l in recent]
        actuals = [l["actual"] for l in recent]
        
        current_accuracy = accuracy_score(actuals, predictions)
        current_f1 = f1_score(actuals, predictions, average="weighted", zero_division=0)
        
        accuracy_drop = self.baseline_accuracy - current_accuracy
        degraded = accuracy_drop > self.alert_threshold
        
        if degraded:
            alert = {
                "type": "model_degradation",
                "message": f"Accuracy {accuracy_drop:.2%} dustu (baseline: {self.baseline_accuracy:.2%}, current: {current_accuracy:.2%})",
                "severity": "high" if accuracy_drop > 0.1 else "medium",
                "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
            }
            self.alerts.append(alert)
        
        return {
            "current_accuracy": round(current_accuracy, 4),
            "baseline_accuracy": round(self.baseline_accuracy, 4),
            "accuracy_drop": round(accuracy_drop, 4),
            "current_f1": round(current_f1, 4),
            "degraded": degraded,
            "sample_count": len(recent),
            "window_hours": window_hours
        }
    
    def get_alerts(self, limit: int = 20) -> List[Dict]:
        return list(self.alerts)[-limit:]

performance_monitor = PerformanceMonitor()
substeps.why: Performance monitor, ground truth (gerçek sonuçlar) geldikçe modelin doğruluğunu hesaplar. Baseline'dan sapma olursa alert oluşturur. Bu 'concept drift' tespiti için temel mekanizmadır.

version: '3.8'

services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.api
      target: production
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL}
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL}
      - MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=http://mlflow:5000
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped

  worker:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL}
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL}
      - MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=http://mlflow:5000
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G

  mlflow:
    image: ghcr.io/mlflow/mlflow:v2.9.2
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    environment:
      - BACKEND_STORE_URI=${DATABASE_URL}
      - ARTIFACT_ROOT=/mlflow/artifacts
    command: mlflow server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000 --backend-store-uri ${DATABASE_URL} --default-artifact-root /mlflow/artifacts
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - mlflow_artifacts:/mlflow/artifacts
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:5000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped

  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: production
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    depends_on:

substeps.code:
from ml.model_card import ModelCard

@router.post("/{model_name}/card")
async def create_model_card(
    model_name: str,
    description: str = "ML model",
    primary_use: str = "Prediction"
):
    versions = client.get_latest_versions(model_name, stages=["Production"])
    if not versions:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Production modeli bulunamadi")
    
    v = versions[0]
    run = mlflow.get_run(v.run_id)
    
    card = ModelCard(model_name)
    card.set_model_details(
        model_type=run.data.params.get("model_type", "unknown"),
        framework="scikit-learn",
        version=str(v.version),
        description=description
    )
    card.set_metrics(run.data.metrics)
    card.add_limitation("Model sadece egitim verisine benzer dagilimdaki veriler icin gecerlidir")
    card.add_limitation("Data drift durumunda performans dusebilir")
    
    path = card.save()
    return {"card": card.card, "saved_path": path}
substeps.why: Model card otomatik olarak MLflow'daki bilgilerle doldurulur. Her modelin dokümantasyonunu oluşturmak production'da şeffaflık sağlar.
